note: Wooded family campground near Larwill, one of the iCampIndiana group, with seasonal sites alongside the overnight ones. Pump-out service on request. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 + $5 holidays and the 3-night holiday minimum. Added 50A (reservation form), 103 sites from the map, mid-April to mid-October, request-form booking. Seasonal share unpublished; not read as mostly seasonal. Not waterfront stands.
flags: GATE: $40 plus tax posted by the operator; +$5 on holidays. Under $50. No gateway within 40 km. Google 4.5 from 74, phone 260-557-6215 (same on the site). No Good Sam/Passport/military statement on the pages read. Reservation form lists Motor Home as a camper type.

LONG-STAY, my read: not mostly seasonal on the evidence, but the split is unpublished. For: 'We have plenty of overnight and weekend camping sites as well as group camping available', a posted nightly rate, a request form for nights. Against: a full seasonal sales page ('Come pick your site now for the 2027 Camping Season', 'We do allow landscaping, floating decks, and non-metal sheds'), and the map doesn't mark seasonal sites. Summer imagery shows relatively few parked units in the open sections but canopy hides the woods. 103 sites on the map; no count of seasonals anywhere. Test 2 passes on the posted rate. Test 4 can't be measured from what is published.

REVIEWS read (Google, newest sort; 5 of 74 loaded): '...the place was beautiful and quit' (4 weeks ago, Halloween weekend), '...we are definitely going back next summer for the season love Stephanie and Brian' (3 years ago), 'Great place to take the RV to camping out.' (2 years ago). Nothing so-so among those five.
AMP CONFLICT: features page says 'Water and electric (30/20 amp)'; reservation form sells 'Pull-thru 50Amp Water/Electric RV Site'. Wrote 50 as the highest.

NOT STATED: max rig length, showers (map shows two 'Bath House' buildings but no page says showers), dump (a map icon near the entrance may be one; unlabelled). Rules say 'NOT PERMITTED' for ATVs and mopeds, ordinary. No odd policy.
PIN: 41.2393,-85.6369 is on the north campground road on imagery, inside the park. No move. Google's 41.2368,-85.6393 is the road corner at the entrance drive.

WATER: not waterfront stands. A pond by the entrance is outside the campground on a neighbouring lot. Rules' 'BEACH/SWIMMING AREA' is not on the map, which shows only a pool: probably group boilerplate.
